signals.quote: We're scaling from four clinics to eleven this year. Our intake and referral coordination breaks a little more with each new site. I need it fixed before the fall openings.
Every clinic has its own intake spreadsheet and referrals get lost between them weekly.
What I care about is timeline and whether this survives contact with healthcare data rules.
I'd want to pilot with our two busiest clinics first. If it works there it works anywhere.
Set up a full demo with Malik, our engineering director. If he's comfortable, we pilot.

commitments.what: HIPAA-compliant with a signed BAA, and eleven sites is a six-week rollout. Both go in writing.

mentions.name: Malik
mentions.context: engineering director who will evaluate the demo before pilot decision
